# Recording recipe (Pringles, generated by tools/recording_plan.py)

## A. Hole-based recipe (recommended)
- 12 arena cells (in view and on the table) are not covered by the strict dataset: (15, -6), (15, -3), (15, 0), (15, 3), (18, 12), (18, 15), (21, -9), (21, 12), (24, -9), (24, 12), (27, -9), (30, -9)
- **record 6 new can-start positions**, each covering holes within 4 cm (the shift regime the strict threshold was calibrated on); 2 demos per position recommended:

| # | x (cm) | y (cm) |
|---|---:|---:|
| 1 | 15 | -6 |
| 2 | 18 | 15 |
| 3 | 30 | -9 |
| 4 | 15 | 3 |
| 5 | 21 | -9 |
| 6 | 24 | 12 |

## B. Pre-registered radius rule (reported, not recommended)
- strict distortion threshold 2.2889; r = 12 cm (largest 2 cm shift bin with median score <= strict, >= 3 rendered candidates)
- arena: 53 grid cells (3 cm) where the can is in view and on the table; 10 existing real demos
- record 0 new can-start positions so every arena cell is within r of a real demo. The score barely depends on shift (visible rear-row ghosts are not reflected in its median), so r saturates; this rule is uninformative here.

| # | x (cm) | y (cm) |
|---|---:|---:|

Coordinates: robot world frame used by sfagen (x small = rear). Mark them on the table with the existing calibration.

## Discrete modes: never synthesized, must be in the real demos (>= 2 each)
- every insertion slot / target receptacle (battery: each slot)
- each object type and grasp type
- object orientations beyond the recorded ones (sfagen translates only)
- each hand-over style if more than one is wanted
